{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for QA orders and remove them
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print("Number of QA orders:", qa_mask.sum())

# Drop QA orders
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, ensure revenue is string type and handle missing values
df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].astype(str)
df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for refunded orders and remove them
refunded_mask = df_clean['status'] == 'refunded'
print("Number of refunded orders:", refunded_mask.sum())

# Drop refunded orders
df_clean = df_clean[~refunded_mask].copy()

# Check for completed orders only
completed_mask = df_clean['status'] == 'completed'
print("Number of completed orders:", completed_mask.sum())

# Filter to only completed orders
df_completed = df_clean[completed_mask].copy()

# Verify channel distribution
print("Channel distribution:")
print(df_completed['channel'].value_counts())

# Verify customer_segment distribution by channel
print("Customer segment by channel:")
print(pd.crosstab(df_completed['channel'], df_completed['customer_segment']))

# Now, compute average revenue per order by channel, stratified by customer_segment
# Group by channel and customer_segment, compute mean revenue
avg_revenue_by_channel_segment = df_completed.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'], as_index=False)['revenue'].mean()

print("Average revenue per order by channel and segment:")
print(avg_revenue_by_channel_segment)

# Compute overall average revenue per order by channel (unstratified)
overall_avg_revenue = df_completed.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].mean()
print("Overall average revenue per order by channel:")
print(overall_avg_revenue)"}
